units.rawText: Youngsters are always so eager to leave the training ground and venture onto the battlefield, as if it's some kind of rite of passage.

units.rawText: Young humans and newly awakened Dolls take the place of the dead and the fallen. Many set off armed with little more than a gun.

units.rawText: But the battlefield is a place of steel and blood. Courage and foolhardiness mean nothing there.
